sources.title: Effective harnesses for long-running agents
sources.finding: Incremental tasks and durable progress artifacts address loss of context; the article does not prove this skill is complete.
sources.planning_impact: Separate audit, feature evidence and final-plan synthesis; preserve unfinished work.

sources.title: Claude Code CLI reference
sources.finding: Print mode and session controls have distinct contracts; nonpersistent execution cannot be assumed resumable.

sources.title: Codex non-interactive mode

sources.title: Antigravity CLI commands
sources.finding: Effort is model-dependent; --continue and --conversation are documented session controls.

sources.title: Antigravity model quotas
sources.finding: The CLI exposes usage/quota inspection; this alone does not prove a selected account has a particular available quota.
sources.planning_impact: Plan per-profile and model-family checks without spending authenticated quota during preparation.

sources.title: Handoffs - OpenAI Agents SDK
sources.finding: Structured handoff inputs and input filters are explicit SDK mechanisms.
sources.planning_impact: Use their separation of metadata and history as an alternative, not proof of cross-CLI session portability.

sources.title: AutoMix: Automatically Mixing Language Models
sources.finding: The abstract reports model routing with noisy self-verification and cost/quality experiments.
